notes.title: Save/Load Issues
notes.notes:
Hi, the game is having save/load issues.  It plays normal if you don't load an old saved game after you update   Sometimes it loads fine, and other times it doesn't.  Hoping to get a fix for these issues soon. 

Btw, The vehicle issue should be fixed when you play a new game with the last update.

Thanks!

notes.title: Updated 9-30!
notes.notes:
Found issues with the main menu button in the options menu (Press Esc.)
I replaced it with Quit Game button since there really isn't a need to go back to main menu and it seems to have resolved some zombie spawn/respawn issues.

I made the Crowbar do less damage.

Sound is back on start screen.

Note:  Players might require a start over because of previous saved data not loading properly.

Thanks!

notes.title: Updated!
notes.notes:
I've updated the game! 

I had to remove the continue button from the Start screen (was causing problems with saved game)

Fixed some save/load bugs, disappearing map and zombie bugs, also some smaller bugs as well.

I've tweaked the vehicles so they use fuel at a slower rate (have more fun driving around longer)

The game will be updated the next time you run it.

Thanks for your support and feedback, I appreciate it!!
